description: US substantial presence test: resident if at least 31 days this year and at least 183 weighted days (all days this year + 1/3 of last year + 1/6 of the year before), after removing exempt-individual days. Closer connection exception and treaties are not checked. US (IRS), as of 2026-11-22. General information only: not tax advice; tax treaties can override the result. Verdict is resident, nonresident or depends.

current.description: Days in the US this year

exemptDays.description: Days this year as an exempt individual etc. (not counted)

prior1.description: Days in the US last year

prior2.description: Days in the US the year before
